# RUN: llvm-mc -disassemble -triple penumbra %s | FileCheck %s
#
# Test vectors generated by pasm.py (Penumbra reference assembler).
#Covers all four instruction formats and all defined opcodes.

#=== Format R: ALU register-register =========================================

0x00 0x00 0x24 0x00
# CHECK: add	r1, r2

0x00 0x00 0x68 0x02
# CHECK: sub	r3, r4

0x00 0x00 0xac 0x04
# CHECK: and	r5, r6

0x00 0x00 0xf0 0x06
# CHECK: or	r7, r8

0x00 0x00 0x34 0x09
# CHECK: xor	r9, r10

0x00 0x00 0x24 0x0a
# CHECK: shl	r1, r2

0x00 0x00 0x68 0x0c
# CHECK: shr	r3, r4

0x00 0x00 0xac 0x0e
# CHECK: sar	r5, r6

0x00 0x00 0x24 0x10
# CHECK: mov	r1, r2

0x00 0x00 0x68 0x12
# CHECK: not	r3, r4

0x00 0x00 0x24 0x14
# CHECK: adc	r1, r2

0x00 0x00 0x68 0x16
# CHECK: sbc	r3, r4

#--- Flag-only variants (F=1) ---

0x00 0x00 0x25 0x02
# CHECK: cmp	r1, r2

0x00 0x00 0x69 0x04
# CHECK: test	r3, r4

#=== Format L: Immediate operations ==========================================

0x2a 0x00 0x40 0x40
# CHECK: lli	r1, 42

0x64 0x00 0x80 0x44
# CHECK: llis	r2, 100

# LLIS with negative immediate (-1 = 0xFFFF in field)
0xff 0xff 0x80 0x44
# CHECK: llis	r2, -1

0xff 0x00 0xc0 0x48
# CHECK: lui	r3, 255

0x64 0x00 0x00 0x4d
# CHECK: add	r4, 100

0xc8 0x00 0x40 0x51
# CHECK: sub	r5, 200

0x2c 0x01 0x80 0x55
# CHECK: cmp	r6, 300

0xf0 0x00 0xc0 0x59
# CHECK: and	r7, 240

0x01 0x00 0x00 0x5e
# CHECK: test	r8, 1

0x05 0x00 0x40 0x60
# CHECK: shl	r1, 5

0x10 0x00 0x80 0x64
# CHECK: shr	r2, 16

0x1f 0x00 0xc0 0x68
# CHECK: sar	r3, 31

#=== Format M: Memory load/store =============================================

#--- Loads (L=1) ---

0x00 0x00 0x48 0xb0
# CHECK: ldw	r1, [r2 + 0]

0x40 0x00 0xd0 0xb0
# CHECK: ldw	r3, [r4 + 16]

0x10 0x00 0x58 0xa9
# CHECK: ldh	r5, [r6 + 4]

0x20 0x00 0xe0 0xad
# CHECK: ldhs	r7, [r8 + 8]

0x08 0x00 0x68 0xa2
# CHECK: ldb	r9, [r10 + 2]

0x04 0x00 0xf0 0xa6
# CHECK: ldbs	r11, [r12 + 1]

#--- Stores (L=0) ---

0x00 0x00 0x48 0x90
# CHECK: stw	r1, [r2 + 0]

0x30 0x00 0xd0 0x88
# CHECK: sth	r3, [r4 + 12]

0x10 0x00 0x58 0x81
# CHECK: stb	r5, [r6 + 4]

#--- Negative offset ---

0xf0 0xff 0x7b 0xb0
# CHECK: ldw	r1, [r14 + -4]

#=== Format B: Branches ======================================================

0x00 0x01 0x00 0xc0
# CHECK: b	0xD0

0xf0 0x00 0x00 0xc4
# CHECK: beq	0xD0

0xe0 0x00 0x00 0xc8
# CHECK: bne	0xD0

0xd0 0x00 0x00 0xcc
# CHECK: bcs	0xD0

0xc0 0x00 0x00 0xd0
# CHECK: bcc	0xD0

0xb0 0x00 0x00 0xd4
# CHECK: bmi	0xD0

0xa0 0x00 0x00 0xd8
# CHECK: bpl	0xD0

0x90 0x00 0x00 0xdc
# CHECK: bvs	0xD0

0x80 0x00 0x00 0xe0
# CHECK: bvc	0xD0

0x70 0x00 0x00 0xe4
# CHECK: bhi	0xD0

0x60 0x00 0x00 0xe8
# CHECK: bls	0xD0

0x50 0x00 0x00 0xec
# CHECK: bge	0xD0

0x40 0x00 0x00 0xf0
# CHECK: blt	0xD0

0x30 0x00 0x00 0xf4
# CHECK: bgt	0xD0

0x20 0x00 0x00 0xf8
# CHECK: ble	0xD0

0x10 0x00 0x00 0xfc
# CHECK: bl	0xD0

#=== Format L: Indirect jump/call ============================================

0x00 0x00 0x40 0x6f
# CHECK: jmp	r13

0x00 0x00 0x40 0x70
# CHECK: jalr	r1

#=== Format R: System instructions ===========================================

0x00 0x00 0x00 0x34
# CHECK: break

0x00 0x00 0x00 0x32
# CHECK: syscall

0x00 0x00 0x00 0x36
# CHECK: eret

0x00 0x00 0x00 0x38
# CHECK: ei

0x00 0x00 0x00 0x3a
# CHECK: di

0x00 0x20 0x20 0x2e
# CHECK: wrsys	r1, 2, 0

0x00 0x21 0x40 0x30
# CHECK: rdsys	r2, 2, 1

0x00 0x10 0x60 0x3c
# CHECK: wrspr	1, r3

0x00 0x00 0x80 0x3e
# CHECK: rdspr	r4, 0
